test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Solve the following equation.

12³ × (16² − 14² − 40) ÷ 2 − 9⁴ = ________.
solution:
**Given:**

123 × (162 − 142 − 40) ÷ 2 − 9⁴

**Concept Used:**

The concept of square is to multiply the same number by itself

**Calculations:**

⇒ 123 × (162 − 142 − 40) ÷ 2 − 94 

⇒ 1728 x (256 - 196 - 40) ÷ 2 - 6561

⇒ 1728 x (256 - 236) ÷ 2 - 6561

⇒ 1728 x 20 ÷ 2 - 6561

⇒ 1728 x 10 - 6561

⇒ 17280 - 6561 

⇒ 10719

⇒ **Hence, The value of above equation is 10719.**
